name: 行政通知や公示送達の方法を変更
summary: 現在は、行政処分などの公示による通知や、税・後期高齢者医療の公示送達を、区の事務所の掲示場に掲示しています。改正後は、不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態にしたうえで、事務所の掲示場への掲示か、事務所の電子画面で閲覧できるようにする方法に変わります。公示による行政通知は、措置を始めてから2週間後に届いたものとして扱います。
changes: 公示による通知を、閲覧できる状態への掲載と事務所での掲示または電子表示で行う
公示による通知は、措置開始から2週間後に到達したものと扱う
特別区税と後期高齢者医療の公示送達を、閲覧できる状態への掲載と事務所での掲示または電子表示で行う
who: 不利益処分の公示通知を受ける人
特別区税の公示送達の対象者
後期高齢者医療の公示送達の対象者
why: 行政手続法等の改正に伴い、公示の方法などの規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes the methods for administrative notices and service by public notice
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Taito City Administrative Procedures Ordinance, etc.
en.summary: Currently, notices given by public notice for administrative dispositions and similar matters, as well as service by public notice for taxes and medical care for older people, are posted on notice boards at the ward's offices. After the amendment, information will first be made accessible for public viewing, and then either posted on a notice board at an office or made viewable on an electronic screen there. An administrative notice given by public notice will be treated as having arrived two weeks after the measure begins.
changes: Make notices given by public notice accessible for public viewing, and post them at an office or display them electronically there
Treat a notice given by public notice as having arrived two weeks after the measure begins
Make service by public notice for special ward taxes and medical care for older people accessible for public viewing, and post it at an office or display it electronically there
who: People receiving public notices of adverse administrative dispositions
People subject to service by public notice for special ward taxes
People subject to service by public notice for medical care for older people
en.why: The ward says this is to update provisions on methods of public notice and related matters following amendments to the Administrative Procedure Act and other laws.
